# Search and shortcuts

Ctrl K (⌘K on a Mac) opens the same command palette in every app: it finds anything by its name or number, and does anything the person may do, without leaving the keyboard.

On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/patterns/search

The previews are the site's illustrations, in HTML, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `muted`), which are
not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX.

## The command palette

- `jl-command-palette`, opened from anywhere by `Ctrl K` (`⌘K`), by the `jl-search-button` at the top of the side nav, and by the same button, `compact`, in the top bar of a phone.
- Its placeholder says what it finds: "Search orders, articles, pages…".
- It searches as people type, by name, number, reference, barcode or id, with the words in any order: the page answers its `search` event with what it found, as commands marked `result`, and `loading` on meanwhile.
- When nothing matches: "Nothing matches “x”. Try a number, a name or a page."

## What it finds

Groups in this order, each holding only what the person may open or do:

| Group | Holds |
|---|---|
| Waiting for you | What needs the person now: reviews to decide, orders to prepare. |
| The things of the app | Orders, articles, workflows, runs, by name or number. One opens on its page, or where the role works on it: an order to prepare opens its picking. |
| Go to | Every page of the side nav. |
| Actions | What can be done from anywhere: "New order…", "Dark theme", "Sign out". |

An action that opens a form ends with an ellipsis: "New workflow…".

## Keys every app shares

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div class="row"><jl-kbd keys="mod+k"></jl-kbd><span class="muted">Search and do anything</span></div>
  <div class="row"><jl-kbd keys="j"></jl-kbd><jl-kbd keys="k"></jl-kbd><span class="muted">Next and previous in a queue</span></div>
  <div class="row"><jl-kbd keys="escape"></jl-kbd><span class="muted">Close what floats</span></div>
</div>
```

| Keys | Do |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl K`, `⌘K` | Open the command palette. |
| `Escape` | Close what floats; leave an edit without keeping it. |
| `Enter` | Send the form; open the row in focus. |
| `Ctrl Enter`, `⌘Enter` | Send the form from a text area. |
| `/` | Go to the search of the list on the page. |
| `J` and `K`, `↓` and `↑` | The next and the previous item of a queue. |
| `?` | Show the keys of the page. |

Inside components (menus, tabs, tables), the keys are the ones of [Accessibility](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/design/accessibility).

## Single keys

- A key with no modifier acts only in a queue where it is the main work: `A` approves and `R` rejects in a review inbox.
- Never while the focus is in a field, and never for what destroys.
- Shown beside the buttons they press, with `jl-kbd`; hidden on touch screens.
- The same key does the same thing in every app.

## Components

[`jl-command-palette`](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/command-palette), [`jl-search-button`](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/search-button), [`jl-kbd`](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/kbd), [`jl-search`](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/search). Their references are in the jlib-official skill.
